newsitem.title: CHINA: China Interbank Market rates (CHIBOR) end mixed.
newsitem.headline: China Interbank Market rates (CHIBOR) end mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said the rates stabilised ahead of the weekend with non-bank financial institutions buying through short-term financial centres, brokerages run by the central bank.
"Banks continued to sell on the secondary market due to sufficient funds," said a trader.
"But non-bank financial institutions increased their borrowing mainly due to today's rally by Shanghai's domestic A share market," he added.
Traders said the rates are likely to go slowly down on expectations of a fall in inflation and possible cuts in interest rate by the People's Bank early next year.
